concept.title: DNS configuration for a manual cluster
concept.shortdesc: To manage a Prometheus DNS record outside Kubernetes, you can use SkyDNS with an etcd cluster to track Red Hat Quay instance addresses.

conbody.p: SkyDNS can run on an etcd cluster. Entries for each Red Hat Quay instance in the cluster can be added and removed in the etcd store. SkyDNS regularly reads them from there and updates the list of Red Hat Quay instances in the DNS record accordingly.
